front.introHead: From the back of the house
front.intro: Behind this East End bungalow, a covered patio runs beside a large covered garage in the fenced yard. The Breakfast Nook opens to the rear deck. Interior laundry is part of the update. Coral Sword and Greenway Coffee on Telephone Road are under half a mile away. Eastwood Park is 0.8 miles away and Downtown is 3.5 miles. The Esplanade on Navigation, Original Ninfa's and El Tiempo are just 2 miles away. Mason Park is about 1.7 miles away.

top.title: The Front Rooms, Open to Each Other

leads.name: Living Room
leads.text: The Craftsman-style front door opens right into the room from the covered porch. A wide cased opening leads straight to the Dining area and the Kitchen, so the whole front of the home works as one space. New floors, trim and lighting carry through.

leads.name: Kitchen
leads.text: Everything is new, set up in an L with a peninsula, dark navy lower cabinets and white shaker-style uppers. The sink sits under a window. The peninsula adds seating and prep space.

details.name: Dining Area
details.text: From the Dining area, the front door and Living Room are on one side and the Kitchen peninsula is on the other.

details.name: Breakfast Nook
details.text: Windows on two walls and a door to the backyard make this a bright, flexible spot. Wood-look flooring matches the Kitchen.

details.name: Breakfast Bar
details.text: Two pendant lights hang over a stone-look counter with room for barstools along it. The pantry is just around the corner.

details.name: At the Range
details.text: A short hall with wood-look flooring leads back toward the main living area. The hall leads to the hall bath and the bedrooms.

bottom.title: A Vaulted Primary and Two New Baths

lead.name: Primary Bedroom
lead.text: The Primary has the only vaulted ceiling in the home, with an exposed painted beam running the length of the room. Carpet runs wall to wall, with room for a king bed, nightstands and a dresser. The doorway to the Primary Bath is on the closet wall, so the bed, the closet and the bath are a few easy steps apart.

baths.name: Double Vanity
baths.text: Double sinks sit in a marble-look top on a dark navy vanity with plenty of drawers. A high transom window sits above and keeps the room private.

baths.name: Hall Bath
baths.text: A tub with a full-height marble-look tile surround, marble-look tile floors and a window over the tub. Deep built-in linen shelves sit just outside the door.

row.name: Primary Closet
row.text: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower down the center, with hanging rods on both sides. The built-ins stay with the home. Carpet carries into the closet.

row.name: Bedroom 2
row.text: Windows on two walls look out to the neighborhood, one on each side of the corner. It's at the front corner of the home, apart from the Primary at the back.

row.name: Bedroom 3
row.text: A large window faces the yard, and a reach-in closet sits beside the door. It has space for a queen bed with a nightstand on each side. Carpet runs underfoot.

back.title: The Yard and the East End

photos.name: Covered patio and garage
photos.text: Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover the space, with a wood plank back wall and a concrete floor. The home also has three-phase power, a plus for heavy-duty equipment.

photos.name: Backyard
photos.text: The fenced backyard has a large mature shade tree and open ground for a garden or outdoor seating. A white wood deck with steps leads out from the Breakfast Nook door.

photos.name: Covered Patio
photos.text: The open patio sits alongside the covered garage, inside the fenced yard. From the back of the lot, the rear of the home shows the same siding as the front.

back.head: What was done
back.para: New Hardi Plank siding and a new roof cover the outside of the home. The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced. New flooring, paint and lighting run through the main rooms. A board and batten gable adds detail at the front. Segundo Coffee Lab on Milby Street is about 1.4 miles away.
back.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room dimensions are approximate, from the listing's floor plan. Living area of 1,385 square feet per HCAD.

extra.name: Closet Wall
extra.text: The double-door closet sits on this side of the room, beside a second window and the doorway. The floor is carpeted.

extra.name: Glass Shower
extra.text: The shower is lined floor to ceiling in marble-look tile, with a sliding glass door. Large-format tile and few grout lines keep cleaning simple. It's all new.

a.text: Walk this East End bungalow and out back, where a covered garage and a covered patio share the fenced yard. A wide cased opening joins the Living Room, Dining area and Kitchen. The Primary has a vaulted ceiling.
